title: Temperature interpolation and a failed extrapolation
promptMarkdown: A first-order reaction has k=0.0150 s⁻¹ at 290 K and 0.0600 s⁻¹ at 315 K. Assuming a constant Arrhenius prefactor and activation energy, calculate E_a and k at 302 K. A measurement at 340 K is 0.0500 s⁻¹. Can the same positive-E_a model describe all three temperatures? Give two mechanistic or experimental alternatives and an experiment to distinguish one.
hintLadder: Solve for Ea using the logarithm of a dimensionless rate ratio.
Check the sign: a positive Ea must make k increase with T.
A rejected model is not a uniquely identified new mechanism.
